title: Claimant Terms for Decision Reviews and Appeals: Withdrawal, Representation, Legacy Opt-In and Decision Notices
content:
# Decision Reviews and Appeals — claimant terms common to the lanes

These terms state, for each lane of Decision Reviews and Appeals, whether the claimant may withdraw a request before a decision, whether an accredited representative may act for the claimant, whether an accredited attorney or agent may charge a fee for the lane after the initial decision, whether a legacy appeal can be opted into the lane after a statement of the case and within what period, and whether the decision notice lists every review option available next.

| Lane | Withdrawal before a decision | Accredited representative may act | Attorney or agent may charge a fee after the initial decision | Legacy appeal may opt in after a statement of the case | Opt-in period after a statement of the case or supplemental statement of the case (calendar days) | Decision notice lists every review option available next |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supplemental Claim | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 60 | Yes |
| Higher-Level Review | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 60 | Yes |
| Higher-Level Review with Informal Conference | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 60 | Yes |
| Board Appeal - Direct Review Docket | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 60 | Yes |
| Board Appeal - Evidence Submission Docket | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 60 | Yes |
| Board Appeal - Hearing Docket | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | 60 | Yes |

## Term by term

1. **Withdrawal.** In every lane the claimant may withdraw the request before a decision.
2. **Representation.** In every lane an accredited representative may act for the claimant.
3. **Fees.** In every lane an accredited attorney or agent may charge a fee for the lane after the initial decision.
4. **Legacy opt-in.** In every lane a legacy appeal can be opted in after a statement of the case, within 60 calendar days after the statement of the case or supplemental statement of the case.
5. **Decision notices.** In every lane the decision notice lists every review option available next.

## Terms read as questions

**Do these terms differ between the regional office lanes and the Board dockets?** No. Each of the five terms reads the same in all six lanes.

**Within what period may a legacy appeal opt into a lane?** Within 60 calendar days after a statement of the case or a supplemental statement of the case.
